faq.question: Can you guarantee reinstatement after a suspension?
faq.answer: No. Amazon decides account status. We help with monitoring, documentation, and structured response where scoped—without inventing outcome guarantees.

faq.question: Is this legal representation?
faq.answer: No. We provide operational Amazon account support. Legal counsel should be engaged when a matter requires it.

faq.question: Do you monitor health only, or also fix listings?
faq.answer: Monitoring and response planning are core. Listing and catalog fixes may be handled here or through catalog management depending on scope.

faq.question: How often do you review Account Health?
faq.answer: Most engagements include a fixed weekly health check plus immediate triage when new notices arrive. Cadence is confirmed in onboarding.

faq.question: Can this run without full-service management?
faq.answer: Yes. Account health can be a focused workstream or included under full-service account management.

faq.question: What documentation do you keep?
faq.answer: We keep status notes on open notices, submissions, and next actions so evidence is available when Amazon requests it.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com.
